column1: # Every bet actually placed on the CALIBRATED engine (from 23 Aug 2026).
# Bets from before the recalibration are archived at
# archive/2026-08-pre-calibration/bets.tsv and are deliberately not mixed in:
# they were priced against probabilities now known to be ~10.8 points
# optimistic, so pooling them would corrupt every cut of this file.
# fixture   must match the fixture name in README.md's tables exactly; the
#           score, Tip 1 rung and Tip 1 probability are joined from there
# rung      the market ACTUALLY bought, which is often neither Tip 1 nor Tip 2
# side      H or A for a team total, - for a match total
# cashout   1 if the position was closed early; the ledger still scores the bet
#           as if held to full time, because that is what tests the tip
